Saint Kitts and Nevis
Consular help:Consular help will be provided bythe Embassy of Bosnia and Herzegovina in Washington or bythe Consulate General in Chicago, USA.
Visa required for the following traveling documentation for BH citizens (Visa shell be issued in Belgrade):
Regular passport YES
Regular biometric passport YES
Service/Official biometric passport YES
Diplomatic biometric passport YES
Citizens of the Federation of Saint Kitts and Nevis are exempted from visa requirement for entry, exit, transit and stay on the territory of Bosnia and Herzegovina up to 90 days, for a period of six months, starting from the day of entry.
